name: Ryan Lee
occupation: Fremont County sheriff (serving through the current term, which ends in January 2027)
prior_offices: Fremont County sheriff (listed on the elected officials directory). County 10 reported in August 2026 that he had announced his retirement in January.
background: Ryan Lee is the Fremont County sheriff, serving through the end of the current term in January 2027. The elected officials directory lists him in that office. County 10 reported in January and August 2026 that he had announced his retirement and that incoming sheriff John Zerga, a lieutenant in the office, takes office in January 2027.
